_comment: AC2 / MIND-LLM-11: this is the reference meeting's `transcript.json`.
PROVENANCE GAP, stated plainly: this is NOT real ASR output. It is the
same segment text as airo_mind_meeting/tests/fixtures/reference_meeting.json
(the hand-authored reference transcript #1633's golden extraction test
runs against), reshaped into the transcript.json wire format
(airo_mind_whisper::transcript_store::TranscriptDocument /
airo_mind_core wire shape) instead of that fixture's own bespoke
{ id, start_ms, end_ms, text } array.
Why: #1636 asks the eval crate to accept a pre-existing transcript.json
fixture rather than requiring live ASR when no model is available. No
whisper model is present in this environment
(rust/airo_mind_whisper/models/ does not exist, and downloading one is
out of scope for a dev-tool crate) -- so there is no way to run real ASR
against rust/fixtures/speech.m4a here, and speech.m4a's own spoken
content is unrelated to this meeting anyway (a separate, short dev-loop
smoke-test recording -- see airo_mind_cli's README).
What this means for the ASR section of a report run against this
fixture: word_error_rate/term_accuracy score the DEFAULT hypothesis
(this same file) against itself, which is a wiring smoke test -- it
proves the pipeline runs end to end, not that any real ASR run scored
well. A real WER/term-accuracy number requires `--hypothesis-transcript`
pointing at an actual whisper run's output. See this crate's `main.rs`
and the issue's final report for the full explanation.
